# Description of workflows and activities

The following activities take place in the workshops and labs of the Global Health Engineering:

1. Mechanical activities:
    1. sensor development
    2. sensor testing
    3. 3D printing
    4. soldering
    5. drilling, cutting wood and metal by hand
    6. laser cutting
2. Biological and chemical activities:
    1. growing fungi cultures
    2. exposure of *Ascaris suum* and *Toxocara canis* eggs (Risk Group 2) to fungal extracts, slurries, secondary metabolites, and acids; incubation at 25–37 °C; microscopic viability assessment (BSL2, see [SOP](../_biological/09_SOPs.qmd#nematode-eggs))
    3. preparation of extracts from spent mushroom substrates
    4. autoclaving of biological waste
